name: interpretive-orchestration
description: Atelier of Co-Apprenticeship for interpretive qualitative research. Human and AI learn together as apprentices to the craft tradition (rigor, reflexivity, theoretical sensitivity).
author: Xule Lin (SKEMA Business School) and Kevin Corley (Imperial College London)

interface.shortDescription: Human-AI partnership for interpretive qualitative research
interface.longDescription: Skills and agents for the sandwich methodology: the researcher codes the first 10-15 documents by hand (Stage 1), works with AI through visible four-stage reasoning (Stage 2), then builds theory in dialogue with the craft tradition (Stage 3). Needs Node.js 18 or later.

skillInstructions: In these skills, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} means this plugin's plugin/ folder, two levels above the skill's own folder. Commands written as /qual-status are typed in Kimi Code as /skill:interpretive-orchestration:qual-status. Before you start qual-parallel-streams, qual-synthesize, qual-code-deductive or qual-characterize-patterns, check .interpretive-orchestration/config.json in the researcher's project. If sandwich_status.stage1_complete is not true and the researcher has not already confirmed in this conversation, tell them what Stage 1 still needs, explain why the manual foundation matters, and ask whether they want to proceed anyway, and why. Asking for the work is not that confirmation: ask, then wait for their answer. Continue only if they confirm.
